_about: The house panel's own readings on 2026-09-04 (UTC clock, hh:mm), as change points: the backup reserve (backup_reserve), the pool (backup_pct) and each source slot (src1..3_pct), from the add-on's own recorder. A reserve-only charge-up: the night charge wrote a 50% reserve, the panel charged the pool to it, and held it one point under it until the restore. All 11 reserve-only charge-ups to a 50% reserve from 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-17 closed at 49; this is one of them, kept whole. reserveHoldPoint.test.ts replays it. `during`: [hh:mm, grid_home_w, panel_load, src1..3 W summed over ±2 min] while the pool held at 49: the slots at 0 W and the house on the grid.
